brand_identity.tagline: Real wisdom is never one voice. It's a whole mind at work.
brand_identity.emotional_tone: Weighty, deliberate, old-world refined, intellectual, authoritative.
brand_identity.aesthetic: Victorian neuroanatomy atlas illuminated by warm sodium light. Marble Senate floors, oak-paneled boardrooms, cathedral stone. Heavy, historic, precise. NOT cyberpunk, NOT AI-slop.

display.usage: Judicial weight, H1/H2, chamber titles, dropped capitals.

body.usage: Editorial text, verdicts, long-form deliberation text.

ui.usage: Navigation, metadata, buttons, labels. Must use tabular figures for numerals.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-8 to p-24) to emulate the physical space of a courtroom or cathedral. Strict alignment.
spacing_and_layout.grids: Symmetric, column-based reading for verdicts (editorial). Asymmetric 'Bento' for archive and council members.
spacing_and_layout.header: Minimal glassmorphism. bg-obsidian/60 backdrop-blur-2xl border-b border-slate.
spacing_and_layout.cards: Subtle 1px border (border-slate), flat backgrounds (bg-carbon). Hover states trigger subtle glow in the chamber's primary color.

motion.cortex_breathing: 4s cycle ease-in-out continuous animation (opacity and scale pulsing slightly).
motion.stagger_reveal: 200ms stagger for council member deliberation reveals.
motion.forge_pulse: Faster, warmer pulse for the Forge (2s cycle, box-shadow ember glow).

components.cortex_svg: Interactive SVG brain map. 4 distinct lobes + central corpus callosum. Hovering over a lobe glows its respective chamber color.
components.question_textarea: Framed as a stone tablet or parchment. border-slate with inner shadow. Focus state: border glows in chamber accent.
components.council_member_card: Minimalist card. Uses SVG glyphs (Laurel, Scales, Sword, Eye) instead of portraits. bg-carbon border-slate.
components.verdict_layout: Editorial style. Large dropped capital in Cormorant Garamond, colored in chamber primary. Source Serif 4 body. Generous leading.
components.forge_quadrant: Cross-chamber indicator showing which voices are feeding into the Forge's synthesis.

images.description: Dark marble for Senate background and stone tablet textures. Apply with low opacity (10-20%) and mix-blend-mode.
Gothic arches and vaulted ceiling inside the Cologne Cathedral for atmospheric background overlays.
Glowing hot coals and embers for the Forge chamber background effect.
Vintage tattered paper texture for the verdict layout and question input background.

media.svg_glyphs_directions: Use sharp, classical vectors. For example: an interlocking laurel wreath for the Statesman, balanced scales for the Strategist, an owl for the Scholar. Render in --bone or chamber accent colors.

pages.landing: Anatomical SVG cortex at the center. Dark void background. Each lobe acts as a clickable region. Title: CEREBRAL CORTEX in Cormorant Garamond.
pages.senate: Subtle dark marble background overlay. Red/Gold accents. Council of 4 figures. Input area for questions.
pages.forge: Corpus callosum chamber. Warmer lighting (Ember/White-hot). Quadrant layout displaying inputs from all 4 chambers synthesizing.
pages.verdict: Single column editorial layout. Dropped caps. Source Serif 4 text. Metadata in DM Sans.
pages.archive: Bento grid of past verdicts. Each card colored faintly with its originating chamber's color.
pages.about: Explains the biological metaphor of the 4 lobes and the Forge.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly use the provided hex codes for colors. Map them to CSS variables as instructed in the spec.
Use Lucide-react or similar SVG library for the council member glyphs.
Use Framer Motion for the 4s breathing cycle, 600ms descent, and 200ms stagger.
Ensure textual contrast. Use text-shadow if placing text over the marble or ember backgrounds.
Implement the app layout without excessive chrome. The header should be minimal glassmorphism.
Do NOT use standard card styles for the verdicts. Treat them like editorial pages.
Configure Tailwind with the exact font families requested and load them via Google Fonts.
Subset first: only build the fully fleshed out views for Landing, Senate, Forge, Archive, Verdict, About.
